description: The image shows a diagram outlining the stages of AI maturity, starting from "Shadow AI" (uncoordinated usage and visibility), progressing through "Grounded AI" (contextual systems and reliability), "Managed AI" (operational systems and reproducibility), and culminating in "Agentic AI" (autonomous actions and accountability), with an arrow indicating "increasing maturity". This diagram appears on Christian Mutaba's LinkedIn post about why AI initiatives stall.
